subject: Comprehensive High School Building Project Update
overview: The School Committee approved the 2026-2027 district school calendar and a resolution to postpone officer elections. The body also reviewed the interim superintendent's strategic self-evaluation and received a detailed progress report regarding the high school building project feasibility study.

items.title: Resolution to Postpone Officer Elections
items.summary: Approved a resolution to conduct officer elections for the 2026-2027 term at the next scheduled meeting, with current officers serving in the interim.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine items including bills, payroll, capital purchases, donations, grants, field trips, and the minutes from the December 15, 2025 meeting.

items.title: Superintendent's Self-Evaluation and Goals
items.summary: Interim Superintendent Suzanne Galusi presented a comprehensive review of district progress, highlighting leadership reorganization, a new instructional vision centered on 'belonging,' and the implementation of the OpenArchitects data platform.

items.title: 2026-2027 District School Calendar
items.summary: Approved 'Option A' for the 2026-2027 school calendar, which sets the student start date for September 2 and ensures compliance with state regulations regarding high school graduation dates.

items.title: Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee Update
items.summary: Member Graham provided a detailed update on the high school building project, mapping out a schedule for educational planning and community design forums required for the upcoming MSBA submission.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee recognized the passing of several local residents and former staff members before adjourning.
